source.name: Juliet Test Suite for C/C++ v1.3, CWE-401 subset

license: NIST Juliet Test Suite v1.3; see the source URL for terms

splits.split_policy: family-disjoint near-duplicate clusters (Jaccard >= 0.85); dev 13 families/60 units, test 29 families/140 units

build.harness: Juliet INCLUDEMAIN; -DOMITGOOD for bad-only, -DOMITBAD for good-only; support io.o/std_thread.o

oracle.consensus_policy: runtime_check.leak_detected matched label for 178/200 units; 22 bad units had no observed leak and must be inconclusive for dynamic methods, not true negatives

notes: Data card pins the stable subset_units.jsonl and archive hashes; it intentionally does not pin the upstream juliet/manifest.json hash because that file is regenerated during upstream verification/build iterations.
Counts and unit IDs must match juliet/subset_units.jsonl; re-run bench_validate_dataset.py after any upstream regeneration.
Sanitization/label-only audit (B9) is not yet complete, so this card does not make LLM/hybrid Juliet results reportable.
Dynamic clean is inconclusive for the 22 bad units with no observed leak; see PROTOCOL section 12.7.

provenance.note: upstream manifest/freeze are regenerated; only stable units/archive hashes are pinned
